chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel ibn Darraj, from Abi Al-Abbas, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When a man divorces his wife during his illness, she inherits him as long as he remains in that illness, even if her waiting period has expired, except if he recovers from it. He (the narrator) said, 'I said, 'And if the illness is prolonged?'' He (peace be upon him) said, 'What is between that and one year.'
ai.seo_question: Does a wife inherit her husband if he divorces her while sick and she completes her waiting period before he dies?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the ruling of 'deathbed divorce' (talaq al-marad), establishing that the wife retains inheritance rights if the husband dies during the specific illness in which the divorce occurred, even if the iddah has technically expired. The narration further specifies that for prolonged illnesses, the period for this inheritance eligibility is capped at one year, reflecting the juristic principle that the illness is considered continuous until a full year passes or recovery is confirmed. This ruling underscores the Shia emphasis on the continuity of the marital bond's legal consequences during the specific context of the illness, distinguishing it from general divorce scenarios.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Abu Al Abbas, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the man divorces his wife during his illness, she would inherit him for as long as (he dies) in that illness of his even if she had fulfilled her waiting period, except if he became healthy from it’. He (the narrator) said, ‘I said, ‘So if that illness is prolonged?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What is between that and a year’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from abu al-‘Abbas who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

If a man divorces his wife during his illness she inherits his legacy as long as it is in his illness even if her waiting period ends unless he gets well from that illness.’ I then asked, ‘What happens if the illness prolongs?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is up to one year.’”
